# ============================================================
#  Antigravity Pipeline - Version Constraints
#
#  This file is used with: pip install -r requirements.txt -c constraints.txt
#
#  PURPOSE: Hard-lock critical packages that MUST NOT be upgraded
#  by pip's dependency resolver, even if a transitive dependency
#  (e.g. datasets -> transformers) requests a newer version.
#
#  DO NOT edit these unless you have re-validated the full
#  pipeline with the new version.
# ============================================================

# ── CRITICAL: GroundingDINO compatibility ────────────────────
# GroundingDINO requires BertModel.get_head_mask which was removed in 5.x.
# This was a confirmed bug (PROJECT_CONTEXT Section 4, Bug #2).
# Pinned to the exact version that resolved it.
transformers==4.47.1

# ── CRITICAL: PyTorch 2.5.1 compatibility ────────────────────
# numpy 2.x introduces breaking changes in the C API that PyTorch 2.5.1
# was compiled against. Allowing numpy>=2.0 causes silent wrong results
# or hard crashes with no obvious traceback.
numpy<2.0.0

# ── Stability pins ─────────────────────────────────────────
# These are not safety-critical but prevent unexpected behaviour changes
# from major-version bumps during a long-running 10K batch job.
pydantic<3.0.0
scikit-learn<2.0.0
datasets<3.0.0
